review: Two develop reviews are implemented as two packages in scope long-ex19, registered in V7_PACKAGES after this run's installed food-air-exposure-trial@1 and thin-slice-food-drying-trial@1, which stay byte-identical. (1) Request: Moss asked for a personally learnable way to obtain or shape a carried stone or flint edge for thin-slice-food-drying-trial@1, with an actual assessment against its contact requirements (edge radius at most 0.0002, hardness at least 8, no fracture or contamination), having roots but no cutting tool and only a visible weathered stone source start-2-stone of unknown suitability. World Agent decision: develop (learning 3) a general shape-and-assess operation with modes select, shape and inspect, exact source or owned inputStackId and optional instrumentIds, whose initial executable modes are selection at a reachable source (one round, 0.2 energy, accessible loose candidates and visible defects only) and direct inspection (one round, 0.2 energy) in adequate light; shaping only for mechanically supported methods with real equipment and otherwise refused before charging; instruments only when acquired and calibrated; each property reported as observed, measured, failed or unverified; no certification, food safety, equipment or reward from registration. Implemented: cutting-edge-assessment@1 (factory cuttingEdgeAssessmentPackage, handler long.cutting-edge-assessment, study 3 rounds at 0.5 energy each). select names a reachable, visible, gatherable non-food material source by sourceId and costs one round and 0.2 energy; it reports the source, material, loose stock and, for one freshly gathered unit, each requirement of the existing stone-edge rule. inspect names one of the person's own carried, unreserved, non-food, non-equipment items of at least one whole unit and costs one round and 0.2 energy; it reports material, whole units, contact-resistance index, edge radius, wear, fracture, contamination and controlled contact under the world contact model, each with its required value, its evidence (visible, or world contact model value for the index), a status observed, model or failed, the list of unmet requirements and whether all are met. Both write an unverified personal record through openRemember and emit cutting-edge-candidates-observed or cutting-edge-inspected with view metadata (rock component, exact item, material, position, zero strokes and chips, edge outline not represented, measured false, no badge). shape is refused before any cost, as are any instrumentIds, unreachable or food sources, food, other people's or reserved items, darkness and energy below 0.2. Finding reported truthfully: the existing contact model (open-hardness-physics scratchPhysical and scratchVisible) gives every unit of a material one index and an unworn edge radius of 0.001 / index, so every intact, unworn whole weathered stone unit (index 8, radius 0.000125) or flint unit (index 9, radius 0.000111) already meets the rule, and both reports say so; no harder rule was invented; the drying trial accepts exactly the pieces the inspection reports as meeting it and refuses those it reports as failing (tested with an intact stone, an oak piece and a stone whose recorded contact state is fractured), still applies its own check and must be learned separately. Refused because the world cannot represent them: shaping, since the world has no fracture, flaking or sharpening law and its only stone contact law, the scratch stroke, wears an edge blunter by 0.00001 radius per stroke and detaches dust; instrument measurement, since no edge-measuring, hardness-reference or contamination-test instrument exists. (2) Request: Ivo asked for a minimal mechanical opening trial of a small owned hazelnut sample with inspection of the actual shell and contents, keeping usable contents separately if feasible, with no eating and no inference of safety or nutrition. World Agent decision: develop (learning 2) a general open-and-inspect operation for shelled material with exact inputStackId, one whole unit per attempt, optional pressureToolIds and supportId: one controlled low-force compression cycle between two checked sound, stable pressure surfaces with a stable lower support on firm ground, in adequate light (one round, 1 energy); inspection and separation (one round, 0.2 energy); separation into contents, shell and lost fragments by represented composition; conservation of mass, age and decay; no fabricated yield; no eating, nutrition, safety or reward. Implemented: shell-compression-opening@1 (factory shellCompressionOpeningPackage, handler long.shell-compression-opening, study 2 rounds at 0.5 energy each). open takes the person's own unreserved, unspoiled, untreated food stack with at least one whole unit that is not soft (hardness index above 1) and exactly two surfaces: one own whole inedible rigid sound item in pressureToolIds and a solid, unreserved object of represented material within reach as supportId, or two own such items with the lower one resting on firm ordinary ground where the person stands; it costs one round and 1 energy through workCreate and workPay. The load reaching the unit is the lower of the two surfaces' strength x (1 - flexibility), strength being hardness / 10; if it is not above the unit's strength the outer layer holds and only the energy is spent; otherwise damage (load - strength) / strength is added and kept on the unit in a shellCompression processing record, splitting the outer layer open at 1 (interior exposed) and leaving it cracked and pressable again below 1. From a larger stack one whole unit is split off through workAllocations and workReserve and released at once, so the rest keeps its identity; a single unit keeps its own id. Stone on stone passes 0.8 and opens a hazelnut (strength 0.4) in one cycle; a fallen-branch surface passes 0.24 and the hazelnut holds; a walnut (strength 0.5) cracks by 0.6 and opens on a second cycle. inspect (one round, 0.2 energy, own food stack, light) records the visible outer layer, crack, whether the interior is exposed, visible deterioration from the decay record (of the interior only once exposed), firmness, quantity, zero scattered material and the unknowns as an unverified approximate record. Events: shell-compression-attempted on every performed cycle, then shell-compression-cracked or shell-compression-opened only when that happens, and shell-compression-inspected, with view metadata (sample, tool and support ids, position, stage, shell intact, cracked or open, contents not separated, no content or shell pile, zero debris, no badge). separate is refused before any cost: the world does not represent shell and kernel, so a hazelnut is one unit with one mass, nutrition and decay; what can be represented is the whole unit's outer-layer state and interior exposure, while contents, part masses, yield and losses cannot be separated, counted, weighed or piled; the World Agent's fallback of a new labeled composition model was not implemented, following the handoff rule to reject the unrepresented part rather than invent it. Every failed check of both packages throws before any charge and spends nothing (tested for each case, including the owner-only rule). Every mode of both packages is one atomic round and nothing is reserved across rounds, so interruption, resume, cancellation and death have nothing to release or refund. Modeling assumptions: adequate light is the world's own daylight threshold, outdoors daylight above 0.1 (the cut at which people are told daylight rather than low light) and indoors dimmed or object light above 0.1; with this world's 80-round day, actions taken from about tick 34 to tick 76 of each day cycle are refused as too dark; owned items are carried, since the world counts every owned stack in carried load, so ownership is the reach check for own pieces and samples and no stack is moved to the person; the person's own position is the work location and no separate work surface is represented for inspection in hand; the contact model's edge radius, wear, fracture, contamination and controlled contact are treated as what direct inspection observes, as hardness-assessment@1 inspection does, while the index is reported as a model value because no hardness reference exists; loose source units are not individually represented, so select reports what one gathered unit would show and finds no visible defects; manual compression between two rigid surfaces is assumed to reach the load the weaker surface passes (the ex17 strike law), within the probe press scale of at most 1; surfaces carry no more than their own strength and so take no damage or wear, consistent with the probe press law and with the contact law in which only the softer body is altered; safe hand placement, ejection, protection and fragment retention are not represented and have no effect; a solid rock or fallen-branch object is a stable support; soft food (index 1 or less) is refused because squashing is not represented; opening changes neither mass, nutrition, eating profile, origin, age nor decay, and food keeps its ordinary ageing. Neither package grants experience, practice milestones, information gain, satisfaction or comfort: records are unverified, the practice evidence events carry no qualified flag, and this run's incentive channel is off, so the caps of both experience reviews hold trivially. Reuse: open-hardness-physics.ts (scratchPhysical, scratchVisible, HARDNESS_SCALE, read on a copy as the drying trial does) and the stone-edge rule of the ex12 bark separation as applied by thin-slice-food-drying-trial@1; the transmission and damage laws, support checks, treatment refusals and firmness and deterioration classes of ex17 mechanical-food-handling@1, reapplied in a new module with ex17 unchanged; the probe press law through openMaterial; a new shared module long-ex19-material-contact.ts (light, firm ground, own whole piece, contact read) used by both packages, as the shell review asks for shared material and contact code; collective-work.ts, openRemember, forest-references.ts and continuous-geometry.ts; gather, pickup and navigate keep their own contracts and costs. Neither package is a first release: both specifications are self-consistent, the edge specification itself directs a selection and inspection precursor when shaping mechanics are missing, and both packages have real costs, real effects on world state (energy, personal records, the cracked or opened unit and the split stack) and observable events; only the parts the world cannot represent, namely shaping, instrument measurement and content separation, are refused before costs.
